english.title: Stopping vehicle in Zebra / Puffin pedestrian crossing controlled area

english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 3, part 5, Schedule 14 of the Traffic Signs Regulation and General Directions 2016, section 36(1) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) The Zebra, Pelican and Puffin Pedestrian Crossings Regulations 1997 are repealed from 22nd April 2016. However these regulations remain in force in relation to Pelican crossings that were established prior to 22nd October 2016 (6 months from the date of repeal) by virtue of regulation 14(5) of the Traffic Signs Regulations and General Directions 2016.
(ii) Paragraph 4 confirms the circumstances when paragraph 3 does note apply.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three penalty points.

Discretionary disqualification.

No endorsement or disqualification if offence committed in respect of a non-motor vehicle.

Fixed penalty ticket - one hundred pounds and licence endorsed three penalty points.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
